summary:
Comprehensive optimization plan for Pen Game on Android and PC, featuring:
- Capped device pixel ratio and dynamic resolution scaling for solid 60 FPS
- Complete removal of compositor-stalling backdrop-filter blurs in favor of optimized dark RGBA surfaces
- Optimized shadow map resolutions and PBR lighting passes
- Responsive slingshot drag with touch-action isolation, predictive trajectory guide, and multi-tier haptic feedback
- Physics simulation delta clamping and garbage-free animation loop
